source: GitHub (bryc/mpkedit issue #20, 'Support for MiSTer N64 saves?')
author: KingKannibal, comment of 2023-11-25: 'Here is what the split saves look like in the current test build of MiSTer Main where they are experimenting with split saves.'
licence: none stated (a file attached to a public GitHub issue)
what_it_is: A separate Time Trial with a ghost, saved by a MiSTer Main test build that split the save: '<stem>.eep' (512 bytes) and '<stem>_1.mpk' to '_4.mpk' (32 KiB each). Pak 1 holds the MARIOKART64 note, 121 pages. Zip entries dated 2023-11-25 14:29.
note: A format that did not ship: released Main names the paks '_N.cpk', not '_N.mpk' (see the other n64-mister entries). Here the paks are in console order (the note reads 'NKTJ'), unlike the single .sav of the same day. The EEPROM differs from the single-file entry's (another run). Copied unchanged into a Mupen64Plus-Next .srm, the game's Controller Pak screen lists MARIOKART64, 121 pages: proof.png is that check (angrylion).
